bio.text: Mike Rounds was sworn in as a U.S. Senator from South Dakota on January 6, 2015.
He previously served as the 31st governor of South Dakota from 2003 to 2011, and was elected five times to the South Dakota State Senate between 1991 and 2000.
Born in Huron, South Dakota, he earned a bachelor's degree in political science from South Dakota State University, built an insurance and real estate business, and lives in Fort Pierre.
